hero.headline: Master Your Body. Control Your Mind.
hero.subheadline: Elite calisthenics coaching for those who demand more than just fitness. We build functional mastery through discipline and relentless progression.

about.name: Alex Rivet
intro: I started training outdoors on my own, with no coach or equipment. My discipline and focus led me to study sports science at a top academy in Ukraine and eventually perform around the world, from France and Chile to Finland and Sweden.

Since 2020, I've coached people globally, created an app with over 10,000 downloads, and reached millions through my YouTube videos. Today, I'm recognized as one of the top calisthenics athletes and coaches. I am here to help you train smarter, gain real strength, and build lasting progress in body and mind.

testimonials.name: Elena Rossi

faqs.question: Do I need any equipment?
faqs.answer: Basic pull-up bar and dip station are recommended, but most foundation work is purely bodyweight.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: The Foundation program is designed exactly for that. We scale the movements to your current capability.

faqs.question: How long until I see results?
faqs.answer: Neurological adaptations happen in weeks; structural changes in months. Consistency is the only variable.
